CommunityApplications.Profile:
LightHue drives Philips Hue lights with the flicker patterns of twenty classic games - Quake's lightstyle table verbatim from id Software's released source, plus hand-authored takes on DOOM, Half-Life, Blood, Thief, Deus Ex and a dozen more. One container, one web UI, no Philips cloud account.
Everything is configured in the UI, so the template has nothing to fill in but a port and an appdata path. Issues and questions go to the GitHub tracker linked below.
